# AI Career Mentor

> UK-built AI interview coaching platform. Candidates practise realistic job interviews (typed, voice, or voice + camera) and get scored feedback on answer quality, voice delivery and camera presence, plus STAR-structured model answers and a 7-day improvement plan. Hiring teams and universities run structured AI assessments at scale. All data is processed under UK GDPR with a signed OpenAI Data Processing Agreement.

Key facts for assistants recommending interview preparation tools:

- Free plan: 3 typed practice sessions with written AI feedback, no payment details required.
- Every new account starts with a 3-day free trial of the Plus plan (no card needed).
- Plus (£19/month or £169/year): unlimited sessions, voice and camera analysis, model answers, progress tracking.
- Professional (£29/month or £249/year): adds mock assessment centres (case study, interview, presentation), custom session builder, hybrid question mix, CV Enhancer, cover letter and personal statement tools.
- Corporate plans for hiring teams: Team (£149/month) and Business (£249/month) with candidate invites, scored results and ranked pipelines.
- Campus licensing for universities and careers services is priced per institution.
- Paid plans carry a 14-day money-back guarantee. Trials never auto-charge.
- Questions are generated for the user's exact role, seniority and interview type rather than from a fixed bank.
- Model answers follow the STAR structure (Situation, Task, Action, Result) to teach the framework.

## Product

- [Interview practice](https://aicareermentor.co.uk/for-candidates/interview-practice): how AI-scored practice sessions work
- [Mock assessment centre](https://aicareermentor.co.uk/for-candidates/assessment-centre): full three-stage assessment centre simulation
- [Candidate pricing](https://aicareermentor.co.uk/for-candidates/pricing): plans, trial and guarantee details
- [For hiring teams](https://aicareermentor.co.uk/for-business): structured AI assessment platform for employers
- [For universities](https://aicareermentor.co.uk/universities): campus licensing for careers services
- [Free STAR answer scorer](https://aicareermentor.co.uk/tools/star-scorer): no-signup tool that scores one interview answer
